(internet).description: the browsers, and anything else that reaches a port published on this box

(docker).description: the docker engine on this box. the agent reads it through its socket, read-only, GET only

frontend.description: caddy, the front door. tls on 80 and 443, serves the built pages, and sends /api to api, /api/streams to home, /chat and /rt to chat, /events to events, /ws and /thumb to video, /voice to voice, /api/metrics to the agent and the stats site to the monitor

monitor-caddy.description: an optional caddy of the monitor's own (STATS_HTTPS_PORT), so the stats site answers while the app's caddy is being recreated

dummy.description: fake streamers for styling and load: bouncing gifs published through video like a browser would, with chat lines. DUMMY_STREAMS of them, 0 by default

api.description: the main http api (api serve). accounts, profiles, groups, going live and stopping, the watch pages and their previews, uploads to s3, the voice grants, and the error reports

chat.description: api chat. the text chat websockets (/chat/*) and the realtime socket (/rt), on redis streams, with the history in postgres

events.description: api events, the gateway. the /events socket: who is here, and the pushes (live, ended, viewers, presence) fanned out from one redis stream

home.description: api home. every live stream and its viewer count in memory, from the same facts, checked against video every 30s, for GET /api/streams

agent.description: api agent. this box's host and container numbers every 15s, from /proc and the docker socket, plus each process's timings from :9300. the monitor pulls them through /api/metrics with OPS_TOKEN

monitor.description: api monitor. checks every box's health, pulls each agent's numbers and the error reports, keeps 7 days of history and serves this page. only ./scripts/deploy.sh stats moves it

video.description: the video relay (webrtc sfu). a streamer's browser sends one copy over udp 7882, and video copies the packets out to every viewer without decoding. also the thumbnails, with ffmpeg

voice.description: voice and screen calls in group channels (webrtc), the same packet copying as video on udp 7883. seats come from grants the api signs

database.description: postgres 17. accounts, profiles, groups, the chat history, the stream log, the presence choices

redis.description: redis 7, in memory only. who is live and who is here right now, the chat streams, and the stream of facts the pushes come from

s3.description: seaweedfs, an s3 bucket on this box, for profile pictures and stream thumbnails, when S3_ENDPOINT points at it

certs.description: makes the self-signed https cert for PUBLIC_IP into a volume for caddy, then exits (0)

pages.description: builds the react pages into a volume caddy serves, then exits (0)

edges.what: the stream, copied out to every viewer
the call, copied out to everyone in it
